backend/main.mo: Implements user profile management, role-based access control, signup with access code, admin role updates, and restricted user listing and deletion.
feature_evidence.json: Describes evidence for a feature adding an admin purge action in the frontend, listing related files, components, and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for various frontend files including hooks, pages, components, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes with utility classes applied globally.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up routing, authentication flow, profile gating, and admin-protected routes using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI component showing an admin-only access restriction message with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Navigation header showing branding, report links, admin users link, and logout handling with query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, main content area, and footer with attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login UI using Internet Identity with a card layout, loading state, and basic branding.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Signup form component handling profile fields, validation, and submitting signup-with-code mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, login flow, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, signup, admin user management, and reports using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining light and dark color schemes and global styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, query client, identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for viewing, deleting users, and purging legacy data with access control and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single service report, handling loading, error states, and structured report sections.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Provides a form to create a new service report with validation, submission handling, and success feedback.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Shows a searchable and filterable list of past service reports with navigation to create new reports.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Contains validation helpers for signup inputs such as required fields, email, mobile number, and admin access code.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting both query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project state, features, and pending admin purge functionality requirements.
